'''Konstantin''' "'''Kostya'''" '''Mikhailovich Khanin''' ({{langx|ru|link=no|Константин Михайлович Ханин}}) is a Russian mathematician and physicist. He served as the [[Chair (academic)|chair]] of the [[Department of Mathematical and Computational Sciences (University of Toronto)|Department of Mathematical and Computational Sciences]] at the [[University of Toronto Mississauga]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Dr. Konstantin Khanin|url=https://www.utm.utoronto.ca/math-cs-stats/faculty-staff/khanin-dr-konstantin|website=MCS Department, UTM|accessdate=22 July 2020}}</ref> 

== Background ==
Khanin received his PhD from the [[Landau Institute of Theoretical Physics]] in Moscow and continued working there as a [[Research Associate]] until 1994.<ref>{{cite web|last1=DeMarco|first1=Carla|title=U of T Mississauga Research Excellence Award recipient delivers thoughtful lecture on self-similarity and critical phenomenon in math and science|url=https://www.utm.utoronto.ca/vp-research/research-campus/researcher-profiles/mathematical-computational-sciences/konstantin-khanin|website=University of Toronto Mississauga|accessdate=18 July 2017}}</ref> Afterwards, he taught at [[Princeton University]], at the [[Isaac Newton Institute]] in [[Cambridge]], and at [[Heriot-Watt University]] before joining the faculty at the [[University of Toronto]]. Khanin was an invited speaker at the [[European Congress of Mathematics]] in Barcelona in 2000. He was a 2013 Simons Foundation Fellow.<ref>{{cite web|title=2013 Simons Fellows Awardees: Mathematics|url=https://www.simonsfoundation.org/funding/funding-opportunities/mathematics-physical-sciences/simons-fellow-program/simons-fellows-awardees-mathematics/2013-simons-fellows-awardees-mathematics/|website=Simons Foundation|accessdate=19 July 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150104134232/https://www.simonsfoundation.org/funding/funding-opportunities/mathematics-physical-sciences/simons-fellow-program/simons-fellows-awardees-mathematics/2013-simons-fellows-awardees-mathematics/|archive-date=4 January 2015|url-status=dead}}</ref> He held the Jean-Morlet Chair at the [[Centre International de Rencontres Mathématiques]] in 2017, and he was an [[Invited talk at the International Congress of Mathematicians|Invited Speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 2018 in Rio de Janeiro. In 2021 he was awarded [[The Humboldt Prize]], also known as the Humboldt Research Award, in recognition of his lifetime's research achievements.<ref>{{cite web|title=Semester on 'KPZ Universality and Directed Polymers|url=http://khanin-shlosman.weebly.com/|website=Jean-Morlet Chair 2017 Semester 1|publisher=Centre International de Rencontres Mathematiques|accessdate=18 July 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=ICTP Alumni Among ICM Speakers|url=https://www.ictp.it/about-ictp/media-centre/news/2017/6/icm-ictp-speakers.aspx|website=ICTP|accessdate=18 July 2017|language=en|date=29 June 2017}}</ref>
